comment: 身份与否证链（§3.7，触发被否证）：GCN 5918（2006-12-14 12:39 UT，Barthelmy）Swift/BAT 触发 250908，标题即带存疑号「GRB 061214(?): Swift detection of a possible burst」，原文明确「this is a 4-msec trigger in the high energy band makes this likely that this trigger is a cosmic ray shower」「The BAT light curve shows nothing significant」；4 小时后 GCN 5923（06/12/14 19:58:34 UT，A. Parsons 代表 BAT/UVOT/XRT 团队）正式否证：「The Swift-BAT trigger 250908 … at 12:16:53 UT, on 14 DEC 2006 is not a GRB. It is due to a cosmic ray shower in the spacecraft. All 29 events recorded in the BAT detector array occurred within a single 100 microsecond timestamp interval.」——纯仪器伪触发，XRT（12:18:15 UT 起 163 s 曝光无源）、UVOT（无候选余辉）、ROTSE-III（误差圆内无新源，GCN 5919）均无独立证据支持该事件。据此不打 tag=grb、不写 extra_data.audit 审核标记，数据全部保留（lc 三行上限均已按契约口径修订，见各行 comment），§3.7 删除请求已在 PR「待决事项」提出，交维护者裁定。该源不在仓内官方目录快照：external/swift_bat、swift_grb、swiftgrbba、heasarc_grbcat、uvot_grb 均
